test_dirname_mixin: test the DirNamesMixin class to verify it lists only non-private attributes on an instance
test_register_accessor: test registering a custom accessor on pd.Series, pd.DataFrame, or pd.Index via pd.api.extensions
test_accessor_works: test that a registered accessor exposes its properties and methods on the pandas object instance
test_overwrite_warns: test that registering an accessor over an existing attribute produces a UserWarning
test_accessor_attribute_error: test that an accessor raising AttributeError in __init__ propagates the error on access
